selection.summary: OCI storage backend config issues (v1.58.x): root-cause evidence delivered. (1) Invalid/unsupported repository schemes (e.g. unknown://) were not clearly validated: internal/config/storage.go validate() only calls oras-go registry.ParseReference, which accepts such input, while flipt's stricter internal/oci.ParseReference (h4: scheme must be one of [http|https|flipt], local refs must use registry "local") is the authoritative parser the config layer bypassed — testdata oci_invalid_unexpected_repo.yml (h10) targets this gap. Fix: add scheme check + clearer error in StorageConfig.validate (reusing internal/oci.ParseReference directly would create an import cycle since internal/oci imports internal/config, h27). (2) Schema gaps: config/flipt.schema.json OCI object (h22) omits bundles_directory and poll_interval though the Go struct OCI supports bundles_directory (h0/h18); config/flipt.schema.cue oci block (h7/h29) likewise omits them. (3) Defaults bug: setDefaults sets "store.oci.insecure" instead of "storage.oci.insecure" and no poll_interval default (h19), unlike git/s3 (h19). (4) OCIAuthentication is mapstructure-decodable but yaml/json "-", and auth/poll_interval are not yet wired to the oci Source (NewSource + WithPollInterval exist, h23/h26; no OCI construction site in internal/cmd/grpc.go). Delivered edits: added PollInterval field to OCI struct, corrected storage.oci.insecure default + added storage.oci.poll_interval default, added bundles_directory/poll_interval to both JSON and CUE schemas; scheme-validation edit still pending due to unique-match constraint on current file revision.
